always_show.description: Container names always shown, even if matched by hide.

default_mode.description: Containers the logs screen opens on: app (application containers, the ones not matched by hide) or all (sidecars and init containers too). Key A switches during a session. Default app.

hide.description: Sidecars: containers not followed in app mode, nor counted in restarts, readiness and version. A name matches that container and name-*; an image name (last path element without tag, e.g. proxyv2) matches containers running it.

show_init.description: Treat init containers as application containers.

version.description: Structure version of this file; must be 1.
